result.description: My Australia Direct   Linesperson Supervisors    Location:  Marrickville, NSW   Employment Type:  Full-Time   About the Role   We are seeking experienced Linesperson Supervisors to lead transmission line crews responsible for the construction, installation, maintenance, and repair of high-voltage transmission infrastructure. This hands-on leadership role will oversee field operations, ensure compliance with safety and quality standards, and coordinate works on transmission networks operating at voltages of up to 500kV. Multiple positions are available.   Key Responsibilities    Supervise and coordinate Linespersons and field crews performing transmission line construction and maintenance works.   Interpret technical drawings, network line diagrams, maps, and engineering specifications.   Oversee the installation, maintenance, and repair of overhead conductors, underground cables, and associated hardware and equipment.   Supervise the installation and repair of transmission towers, poles, conductors, cables, insulators, and related electrical infrastructure.   Coordinate transmission line works on structures and assets operating at voltages up to 500kV.   Operate and supervise the use of plant, lifting equipment, and elevated work platforms (EWPs).   Conduct inspections, identify defects, and ensure infrastructure is maintained to required standards.   Supervise work at heights, including climbing transmission towers and poles.   Provide technical guidance, training, and mentoring to team members while coordinating daily work activities and resources.  Liaise with project managers, engineers, network operators, contractors, and management regarding project progress and operational requirements.  Ensure compliance with safety procedures, permit systems, and regulatory requirements.    About You   To be successful in this role, you will have:   Relevant tertiary qualifications OR equivalent work experience    Extensive experience in transmission line construction, maintenance, or electrical linework.  At least 3–5 years' experience in overhead and underground line installation, maintenance, and repair  Previous supervisory or team leadership experience.  Strong knowledge of transmission network infrastructure and safe work practices.  Ability to interpret technical drawings and engineering documentation.  Experience working at heights and with plant and lifting equipment.  Excellent leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills. About the Opportunity  Our client, a well-established macadamia farming operation, is seeking motivated and reliable Farm Hands to support their operational, maintenance, development, and irrigation activities. This is a hands-on role suited to individuals whoenjoy working outdoors and being part of a productive agricultural team. 
 You will be a valued team member working in a fast-paced environment that has a focus on safety and wellbeing. We can offer you industry training and supportive management. This role is available for 9 months, working a minimum of 120 over a four-week period with potential for overtime and weekend work.  
    Key Responsibilities  In this role, you will be involved in a variety of farming activities, including: 
 
 Land development and preparation 
 Planting, pruning, fertilising, slashing and mulching 
 Irrigation and harvesting activities 
 Farm maintenance and drainage work 
 Machinery operation and basic maintenance 
 Chemical spraying (where appropriately licensed) 
 Monitoring crop health, including identifying pests and disease 
 Maintaining accurate records (e.g. chemical use, irrigation, maintenance, timesheets) 
 Supporting continuous improvement in farming practices and safety systems 
 
 For more experienced candidates or Leading Hands, responsibilities may also incldue:  
 
 Calibrating machinery and equipment 
 Implementing pest management strategies 
 Supervising farm hands and coordinating day-to-day activities 
 
  Award: Horticulture Award 2020

  Current Driver's Licence (essential)  
  Pass a Pre-employment medical check including drug alcohol test  
  Physical Stamina, Attention to detail, Strong Work Ethic and willing to work as part of a diverse team  
  Be able to provide two reference checks  
  Immediate start possible  
  Availability across day and afternoon shift - Early morning and Mid-afternoon starts depending on your assigned role and previous experience.
